faq.q: Should I buy 1 ton or 1.5 ton?
faq.a: 1 ton for rooms up to 100 sq ft (small bedrooms, study rooms). 1.5 ton for 100-180 sq ft (master bedrooms, medium living rooms). 2 ton only for 180+ sq ft or rooms with heavy sun exposure.

faq.q: Is inverter AC worth the extra cost?
faq.a: Yes — inverter ACs use 30-40% less electricity and run quieter. The payback period is typically 2-3 years through electricity savings.

faq.q: Which brand is best for AC service in India?
faq.a: LG, Samsung, Daikin, and Voltas have the widest service networks. Lloyd and Carrier are improving but have sparser coverage in smaller cities.
